author: C. T. Hubbard
title: Judy Chu criticizes GOP actions on spending priorities and transparency
text:
Judy Chu, U.S. Congresswoman representing California’s 28th district since 2009, addressed several issues in a series of posts on March 25, 2026. Her comments focused on federal spending priorities, transparency in government actions regarding Social Security data, and ongoing recovery efforts following the Eaton Fire.
In a post at 16:31 UTC, Chu criticized former President Trump’s use of federal funds: “Over and over again, Trump has taken billions of American tax dollars for everything other than what the American people actually need. While Americans are facing an affordability crisis, Republicans are choosing to funnel money away from feeding families, supporting our https://t.co/3zg4sQ2dVe” .
Later that day at 19:04 UTC, she commented on Republican legislative actions: “Republicans are once again keeping the American people in the dark. Today, Republicans quietly passed a rule blocking Democrats’ attempts for full transparency from this White House. They are hiding the mishandling of Americans’ sensitive Social Security data. They are hiding” .
At 23:14 UTC on the same day, Chu referenced local disaster recovery efforts: “It’s been over a year, and families in my district are still recovering from the Eaton Fire. They are fighting to rebuild their homes, communities, and lives. And many have just begun to receive settlement offers. Today, I joined @WaysMeansCmte to stand for natural disaster https://t.co/O1315TXgVA” .
Chu has represented California’s 28th District since replacing Hilda Solis in Congress in 2009 and previously served in the California State Assembly from 2001 to 2006. Born in Los Angeles in 1953 and currently residing in Monterey Park, she is an alumna of UCLA with a bachelor’s degree earned in 1974.
